title: Data shapes: A, B and C ready on one branch

owner_note.text: integration/data-shapes holds all three builds plus one fix, tested together, and is served at http://data-shapes.localhost/. Merge this branch alone with merge.mjs, never the three build branches one by one: C on its own would bring back a broken test.
